senses.gloss:
Odana is a common expression denoting a mess, usually of grain cooked with milk (kṣīra-pākam odanam). Special varieties are mentioned, such as the ‘milk-mess’ (kṣīraudana), the ‘curd-mess’ (dadhy-odana), the ‘bean-mess’ (mudgaudana), the ‘sesame-mess’ (tilaudana), the ‘water-mess’ (udaudana), the ‘meat-mess’ (māṃsaudana), the ‘ghee-mess’ (ghṛtaudana), etc.
